notes.title: Merry Christmas! Update 0.44 is now available!
notes.notes:
🎄✨ Merry Christmas! 🎅✨
We’re thrilled to bring you a new update packed with fun and surprises. Here’s what’s new in version 0.44 of Ragdoll Universe!

🗺️ New map for Challenge Mode (1 player):
"Anomaly": Dive into a mysterious hotel inspired by memory and investigation games. Discover and resolve anomalies to escape the loop. Will you rise to the challenge?

🗻 New map for Versus Multiplayer Mode:
"Snowy Mountain": Compete with your friends on the peak of a snowy mountain filled with Christmas spirit. Only the last elf standing will earn Santa’s favor. HOHOHO!

🔧 Minor tweaks and improvements:
Small fixes and adjustments to keep the experience smooth and exciting.

Once again, thank you for your support and we wish you all Happy Holidays. See you in the game! 🎮

notes.title: # Update 0.43
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

After a short break following the launch, we’re diving into the exciting journey of periodic updates. My goal is to deliver weekly updates, and while this first one may not include a large amount of new content, there’s a good reason for it: I’m focusing on improving the game’s programming, experimenting, and testing new mechanics to provide a more diverse and enjoyable experience.

Update 0.43:

New map in Challenge mode: Street Of Ragdoll
New map in Challenge COOP mode: Hold Out
New map in Versus mode: Game of Death
New reward available in the SHOP REWARDS: RaceTrack
Other small tweaks and improvements.
Thank you for your continued support. This is just the beginning of what’s to come!

notes.title: Launch and Skin Editor!
notes.notes:
[h1]Launch and Skin Editor![/h1]

Hello to all the followers of my game!

First of all, I want to apologize for the delay in the launch. It was necessary due to some technical issues that needed to be resolved to offer you the best possible experience.

During this week, I have been able to implement some new features:

Improved pause menu: Now available in all scenes, where you can see the objective of each challenge and how to win it.

Skin customization system: Accessible from the main menu, you can configure your own skin to use in any scene of the game, alternating between the default skin or your personalized one.

I want to apologize again for the delay and assure you that there will be constant updates every week with new multiplayer maps and challenges.

Note about the sandbox mode: Please note that the sandbox mode is still in a very early phase. It only includes the map and the extras that can be unlocked, such as the car, helicopter, a very basic construction mode, and more. My intention is to create an adventure within that mode in future updates.

If you prefer to wait for the demo due to doubts, I will soon release it so you can try the character controls and get an idea of the game before purchasing.

A little joke: I left the skin without clothes in the sandbox mode because I didn't have time to dress it, so better not go there yet!

Thank you for your understanding and continuous support. I'm excited to finally share the game with you!

notes.title: Devlog #2 | Release Date
notes.notes:
Hello again to all the followers of my game!

I'm excited to announce that the game will be released next Friday, the 25th. During this time, I've been working hard on new mechanics, maps, and overall improvements to offer you the best possible experience. I've also been organizing the roadmap for future updates and realized how important it is to launch the game at this early stage. I need your feedback to know what you enjoy the most and where I should focus my development efforts.

New Features and Improvements
Split-Screen Local Multiplayer: I've implemented split-screen, opening up a world of possibilities for game modes and map distribution in local multiplayer.

Passengers on Vehicles: It's now possible for passengers to board the vehicles included in the game. This adds a new layer of strategy and fun, as you can cooperate or compete while driving.

New Maps

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127483/5dc2b01aa2e682884ed9f013277464888514691f.png[/img]

Temple: A local multiplayer map featuring pillars that descend toward lava at intervals. You'll need to grab onto vines to avoid falling. Will you be brave and wait until the last moment fighting before grabbing on, or will you hold on as quickly as possible, exposing yourself to attacks from your opponents?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127483/5de9cb494d28baa29f851bbe2eee64cbb359511a.png[/img]

Shark Cave: Escape from a shark while battling against other players. There's a cage that protects you from the shark, but it's small and not everyone fits. Characters can now swim, which allows me to create future underwater maps and zones.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127483/e969574c1da7b3ff264464cbead4f919bbb8a481.png[/img]

Ruins: Designed to debut the split-screen mode, this map is set in an area of very similar ruined buildings, making it hard to tell where you're being shot from. Watch out for surprises!

Next Steps
I'm continuing to improve various aspects of the game and plan to incorporate Steam services like achievements and Steam Workshop. I'll also add more maps, game modes, and, most importantly, implement skin customization.

I'm eager to hear your opinions and suggestions. Your feedback is essential to help me focus development on the areas that interest you most.

Thank you for your continued support and for being part of this adventure! See you on Friday the 25th.

notes.title: Devlog #1 | Expanding the Universe
notes.notes:
Hello to all the followers of my game! I want to sincerely thank everyone who has added the game to their wishlist on Steam. Your support is invaluable and motivates me to keep working hard.

I've been very busy these past few months since launching the game's page, striving to offer you a public version that is as playable as possible. Although the game isn't finished yet and is in early access, I believe I'll be able to release it on the 17th of this month. This version will give you a clear idea of the direction I'm taking, and I'm sure you'll enjoy experiencing the sensations of controlling these ragdoll physics characters.

I'm releasing this version because I need your feedback to know what you'd like to include in the future, such as new maps, challenges, or features in the sandbox mode.

News and Improvements
Character Refactoring: Characters now look taller, and the joints are better connected for a smoother experience.
Smarter Enemies: Zombies now have biting animations and can find you more easily, increasing the challenge.
Increased Gamepad Compatibility: I've improved vehicle controls and building structures in sandbox mode using gamepads.
New Challenges:
MMA Map: Face off in intense hand-to-hand combat.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127483/5ec137eeefad3a66cf014cbcb7921443c6fd7845.png[/img]
Desert Shooter: Test your aim in arid scenarios.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127483/d2029511738d45a5d22258ea03671b8b9ffbdff9.png[/img]
Missions on Mars: Explore the Red Planet and overcome unique obstacles.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127483/e38897f759dcc935b6ca0aadb1310130fd402d4a.png[/img]
Local Multiplayer Mode: It's now possible to play with up to 4 players on the same screen.
New Local Multiplayer Maps:
MMA Ring: Fight against your friends in the ring.
Carpentry Workshop: An interactive environment full of tools and surprises.
Street Soccer Field: A fully functional soccer match where you can kick the ball or your opponent.
Minor Improvements: In the "Rescue the Princess" map, you now carry the sword on your back and can equip or unequip it as needed.
I'm eager to hear your opinions and suggestions. Please don't hesitate to share your experiences and tell me what else you'd like to see in the game!

[previewyoutube=drUEspD13Nw;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you for being part of this adventure!
